rationale: CSD14 (OO family closure #613, surfaced by fsharp corpus deep differential): target-typed new() inside collection/array initializers must resolve to the member's ELEMENT type (EnumSettingEntry[] ExtensionChoice = [new(), ...] -> EnumSettingEntry), never the member NAME (the old direct-child scan fabricated ExtensionChoice->ExtensionChoice self edges that the analyzer and oracle SHARED, invisible to the differential). Direct property/field initializers resolve to the declared type base; a new() nested in a call argument resolves to nothing (honest no-edge). Grid nests array-in-array to pin multi-level element stripping.
